title: cfad: Characteristic Function Anomaly Detector for Financial Time Series
description: Research-oriented Python software for detecting distributional-shape changes in financial returns. CFAD compares rolling empirical characteristic functions with Gaussian characteristic functions fitted to the same window mean and variance, then monitors the resulting real-frequency discrepancy score with two-sided Page-CUSUM. The repository also provides parametric CF models, goodness-of-fit tools, backtesting, bootstrap diagnostics, notebooks, and optional Cython acceleration.
